records.title: Unified Data Selection for LLM Reasoning
records.reason: The primary arXiv paper proposes High-Entropy Sum data ranking to reduce reasoning-data selection/training overhead (including training on a 20% subset); the measured efficiency is training-time, not model inference or serving.

records.title: A Survey of Audio Reasoning in Multimodal Foundation Models
records.reason: The primary paper is a survey, not a new serving method. Its latency section documents the accuracy/latency tension for streaming audio reasoning and says uncompressed long-audio features can create prohibitive sequence lengths, but it does not validate a specific deployable efficiency method; keep as weak adjacent evidence.

records.title: Deformba: Vision State Space Model with Adaptive State Fusion
records.reason: Deformba is a vision-only state-space architecture. Full text establishes linear input-length computation versus quadratic global attention and estimates FLOPs, but evaluations are 2D/3D visual perception only, with no LLM/VLM serving evidence; transferability remains weak.

records.title: DyGRO-VLA: Cross-Task Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Grouped Residual Optimization
records.reason: The primary paper is a VLA reinforcement-learning optimizer for cross-task policy training and success rates; it does not measure inference compute, memory, latency, serving, or token use.

records.title: How Off-Policy Can GRPO Be? Mu-GRPO for Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Mu-GRPO reduces generation/optimization switching overhead and reports about 2x wall-clock speedup during RL post-training. The improvement is explicitly training-system throughput, not deployed LLM inference.
